segments.comment: Normal mode: the hero picks up an unpaid potion in a D:2 general store and kicks the shop wall until it kills him, with the peaceful keeper two squares away. The bill alone selects shk.c inherits()'s "takes" arm, its !m_next2u() branch adds "comes and", and end.c really_done() appends the message beside the pending "You die..." before display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE). Seed 41190016 is the only one of 41190001-41190100 for which a port-only scan found a route of at most 30 steps to the D:1 downstairs and at most 45 steps on D:2 to a single shop object beside a wall, away from the keeper.
